items.stem: Define the term 'water scarcity'.
items.answer: The shortage of water for meeting needs, caused by low supply or over-use and unequal access.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for the idea: the shortage of water for meeting needs, caused by low supply or over-use and unequal access.

items.stem: Why is there water scarcity even in areas with sufficient water?
items.answer: (1) Water is polluted by domestic and industrial wastes, chemicals and fertilisers. (2) Over-exploitation and unequal access leave many without enough clean water.
items.markingKey: 1 mark each: (1) Water is polluted by domestic and industrial wastes, chemicals and fertilisers. (2) Over-exploitation and unequal access leave many without enough clean water.

items.stem: Why has industrialisation increased the pressure on fresh water?
items.answer: (1) Industries use large amounts of water. (2) They also need power, much of which comes from hydroelectricity.
items.markingKey: 1 mark each: (1) Industries use large amounts of water. (2) They also need power, much of which comes from hydroelectricity.

items.stem: Describe three causes of water scarcity in India.
items.answer: (1) Growing population needs more water for domestic use and food production. (2) Expansion of irrigated agriculture and over-use of ground water. (3) Urbanisation and industrialisation. (4) Pollution of available water.
items.markingKey: 1 mark each for any three points: (1) Growing population needs more water for domestic use and food production. (2) Expansion of irrigated agriculture and over-use of ground water. (3) Urbanisation and industrialisation. (4) Pollution of available water.
